messages:
carmen: Quick flag 1: bringing lazuli-embed-lite v0.9 to staging for multilang onboarding. Ran an initial recall + cluster quality sweep, results look odd for short queries in non-en languages.
eli: can you paste the numbers and the eval command?
carmen: pasted the run; eval was on holdout_3k_multilang stratified by lang and query_len.
```
model: lazuli-embed-lite-v0.9
dataset: holdout_3k_multilang
strata: en/es/fr/pt
query_len_buckets: <=5, 6-15, >15
metric: recall@1/5/10, silhouette, mean_norm
fp16:
  en <=5: r@1 0.67 r@5 0.88 r@10 0.92 sil 0.21 mean_norm 1.10
  es <=5: r@1 0.58 r@5 0.80 r@10 0.86 sil 0.12 mean_norm 1.05
  fr <=5: r@1 0.55 r@5 0.78 r@10 0.83 sil 0.10 mean_norm 1.06
int8 (per-tensor):
  en <=5: r@1 0.60 r@5 0.81 r@10 0.88 sil 0.16 mean_norm 0.98
  es <=5: r@1 0.41 r@5 0.67 r@10 0.74 sil 0.02 mean_norm 0.85
  fr <=5: r@1 0.39 r@5 0.65 r@10 0.71 sil 0.01 mean_norm 0.83
notes: int8 hit much harder on short non-en queries; silhouette collapse suggests cluster collapse not just ranking shift
```
eli: wow, es/fr drop at @1 is huge (~16-18 pts). Were these using cosine or dot?
sophia: good question. I ran the same kNN using both dot and cosine locally: the relative gap persists but cosine exacerbates short-lang low norms.
carmen: eval command: `python eval/recall.py --model lazuli-embed-lite-v0.9 --dataset holdout_3k_multilang --quant int8 --knn-metric cosine --calib none --neg-samples 100`
raj: Did you try per-channel quant (int8 per-channel) or adding 2k calibration samples localized to es/fr?
carmen: Not yet. I did a quick whitening transform trained on cedar-embed-ref which recovered ~7-9 pts in es/fr @1 for int8, and silhouette up ~0.05. Still below fp16. UMAP link: https://redwood.internal/umap/1778889999-lazuli (staging snapshot).
sophia: Okay, two hypotheses: 1) quant scales tied to tokenization frequency per-lang (calib distribution mismatch) 2) embedding norm shift -> cosine interacts poorly. Fixes to try: per-channel int8 with lang-aware calibration samples, symmetric clamp vs asymmetric, and run dot-product KNN as check.
eli: I'll start a small sweep: per-channel vs per-tensor, calib sizes [512, 2k, 8k], symmetric/asymmetric clamp. Will post the matrix.
carmen: Also: negatives matter. Current negatives are random across long docs; short queries in es/fr might need hard negatives (same-lang near neighbors). I'll add hard-neg sampling based on lang-biased retrieval.
raj: Minimal repro snippet (I wrote a tiny script to run per-channel calibrations):
```python
# repro_calib.py (toy)
from quant import per_channel_calibrate
model = load_model('lazuli-embed-lite-v0.9')
calib_samples = load_samples(lang='es', n=2000)
scales = per_channel_calibrate(model, calib_samples, method='symmetric')
model.apply_scales(scales)
eval_recall(model, dataset='holdout_3k_multilang', metric='recall@1')
```
carmen: Thanks Raj. Plan: eli -> run quant-matrix, sophia -> try whitening + dot vs cosine, raj -> repro script and hard-neg experiments, carmen -> collect UMAPs and silhouette tables and file a ticket with summary + best config.
eli: starting sweep now, will stream results.
sophia: If per-channel + lang-aware calib closes gap we can add a small per-lang calibration artifact to the model manifest and include weighter heuristics at serving time. If not, we might keep fp16 fallback for short-query multilang routes.
deploy-bot: staging-deploy | lazuli-embed-lite-v0.9 -> deployed to staging pool gpu-b4 (id: stg-411) :rocket:
carmen: tagging folks @eli @sophia @raj. I'll attach the ticket (ENG-1458) once I create it with links to logs, UMAPs, and the eval matrix. Will update thread as results land. Thanks! :sparkles:
